title.suggested: Tom Allen badly beaten in front of his saloon

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reported that Tom Allen was badly beaten in front of his Market Street saloon; he was first reported shot, but the bullet missed him, and his bartender came to his rescue.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Friday Morning, July 1, 1898.

facts.fact: Allen was badly beaten early in the morning in front of his saloon on Market near Sixth; a report that he was shot proved wrong as the bullet missed him, and his bartender came to his rescue
places: Market near Sixth street, St. Louis

notes: Tear hides words mid-line, so details of the rescue and assailant are partly lost.
